description: A PHP class representing an installed Composer package within Drupal, including methods to create instances from array data and to extract Drupal project names from package info files.

classes.name: InstalledPackage
classes.description: A value object that models an installed Composer package, with capabilities to determine Drupal project names based on package metadata.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an InstalledPackage instance from an array of package data.

methods.name: getProjectName
methods.description: Returns the Drupal project name if available, based on package type and info files.

methods.name: scanForProjectName
methods.description: Recursively scans package directory for `.info.yml` files containing a `project` key to determine the project name.
